name: RenameMailFolder
description: Renames a specified mail folder in a Microsoft 365 mailbox using the Microsoft Graph API. Optionally, you can update the visibility status of the folder.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: __CredentialId__M365
fields.label: Microsoft 365 Credentials
fields.description: Microsoft 365 credentials used to authenticate and access mailbox data through the Microsoft Graph API.

fields.name: MailboxAddress
fields.label: Mailbox Address
fields.description: The email address of the mailbox where the folder will be renamed. If left empty, the authenticated user's mailbox will be used.

fields.name: DisplayName
fields.label: New Folder Name
fields.description: The new name to assign to the folder.

fields.name: FolderId
fields.label: Folder ID
fields.description: The unique ID of the folder to be renamed.

fields.name: IsHidden
fields.label: Visibility
fields.description: Indicates whether the folder should be hidden from the mailbox view after renaming. Set to 'true' to hide, or 'false' to make it visible.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Renaming Result
fields.description: The result of the folder renaming, including the updated folder ID, name, and visibility status.
